We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. No SMILES given. We need to retrieve data? Possibly the sample is provided via environment? We have tools to get spectra. Could infer carbonyls from IR (C=O stretch ~1700 cm-1) or carbon NMR (carbonyl carbon ~190-210 ppm). But we need the compound structure. Maybe the system has a sample context not shown. Could request carbon NMR spectra? That would show peaks. But we need count of carbonyl groups. Could also request IR to see number of C=O peaks. Usually carbonyl stretch appears as strong peak around 1700 cm-1. If multiple carbonyls, may have multiple peaks or same region.

Better to request IR spectra. Use function ir_spectra.
